run.name: 05-bar-chart
run.finalText:
I built the "Revenue by quarter" chart in the Main comp. I checked it on a contact sheet before the last fix, then confirmed at 1.0s that nothing shows before the bars start. I haven't replayed the full animation since that fix.

- **Title:** "Revenue by quarter" sits top-left with a small "$M, fiscal year" subtitle. Both fade in.
- **Axis:** the baseline draws outward from its center from 0.4s to 1.0s. The Q1–Q4 labels fade in under it, one after another.
- **Bars:** Q1 to Q4 grow up from the baseline one after another, starting at 1.1, 1.5, 1.9 and 2.3s. The bars are slate grey.
- **Value labels:** "$12M", "$18M", "$15M" and "$27M" each fade in and rise slightly just before their bar finishes growing. They fade in rather than count up.
- **Q4 highlight:** the Q4 bar turns orange at about 3s and gets a small springy pop. Its "$27M" label is larger and orange, and it scales in with an overshoot.

At 1.0s the grown bars and value labels aren't on screen yet. Before that fix, the Q3 and Q4 bars showed as thin hairlines early because their height starts at 0.

I can make the labels count up from 0 by stepping through values, or switch to a dark theme. Say which you'd like.

items.text: bars grow from the baseline (size/scale animated, bottom edge fixed)
value labels present (≥4 numeric text layers)
accent highlight on Q4 (≥2 bar colors)
